payload.name: VoteMapper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask about a US election — the 2026 midterms ahead, or any presidential election since 1788 — and get an answer with a date on it.

For 2026: the consensus competitiveness rating for any of the 100 Senate seats and 435 House districts, a consensus of Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball, along with which races are genuinely in play and what forecasters have changed their minds about since the last update.

The part a chat assistant cannot do on its own is the arithmetic. Describe a scenario in plain language — "Republicans hold every toss-up but lose Maine" — and VoteMapper resolves it against the ratings in effect and returns a full chamber map you can argue with. Click any race to reassign it and the tally follows. The Senate has 65 seats that are not on the 2026 ballot and are already counted; getting that right is the difference between a real answer and a confident wrong one.

For history: every presidential election from 1788 to 2024, as a map rather than a paragraph. Compare two elections and see which states changed hands, trace one state's whole voting history and current streak, or reassign states to ask what a different outcome would have meant. Multi-way elections like 1860 and 1912 come back whole rather than flattened into two parties.

You can also check a sealed VoteMapper forecast. A prediction declared in the app is verified here by fingerprint and scored against published race calls once results land — over called races only, so an uncalled race is never counted as a miss.

VoteMapper is a simulator. It reports no live vote counts, returns or called races, and its historical data holds electoral votes, not popular-vote totals. Every answer carries the date its data was published, both parties are treated symmetrically throughout, and the connector takes no position on any race.

Read-only and stateless: no account, no sign-in, nothing written, nothing retained between requests.

payload.name: Flash
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flash is a spaced-repetition flashcard app that ChatGPT can run for you. Tell ChatGPT what you're learning — paste a chapter, lecture notes, a vocabulary list, or just describe the topic — and it writes the cards into a deck in your Flash account. When you want to study, say so: ChatGPT asks each due card, checks your answer — typed, or dictated with the mic — and grades it Again, Hard, Good, or Easy. Grading is strict on numbers, doses, ranges, units, and names, which makes it a good fit for nursing, medicine, law, languages, and anything else where "close enough" isn't.

Every review is scheduled by FSRS, the modern spaced-repetition algorithm that models your memory and shows you each card right before you'd forget it. There are no settings to learn.

Nothing you drill with ChatGPT scrolls away: cards, answers, and review dates live in your Flash account, synced across devices, and you can also study on the web at flashmemorize.com. Existing Anki decks import whole (.apkg with cloze, hints, images, audio, LaTeX, typed answers, and nested decks), and everything exports back to Anki or CSV at any time.

What ChatGPT can do once connected: list your decks and due counts, create decks and cards, start and run a study session, reveal answers, submit grades, edit or delete cards, and adjust daily new-card limits.

A free Flash account is all you need. Flash has no ads, no tracking, and no third-party analytics.
payload.longDescription:
Flash 是一款间隔重复闪卡应用，ChatGPT 可以代你操作。告诉 ChatGPT 你在学什么——粘贴章节、课堂笔记、词汇表，或只描述主题——它就会把卡片写入你的 Flash 账户中的牌组。想要学习时，告诉它即可：ChatGPT 会逐张提问到期卡片，检查你的答案（可输入，也可用麦克风口述），并按“重来”“困难”“良好”或“简单”评分。对数字、剂量、范围、单位和名称的评分很严格，因此很适合护理、医学、法律、语言学习，以及任何不能“差不多就行”的领域。

每次复习都由 FSRS 安排。这是一种现代间隔重复算法，可模拟记忆情况，并在你即将遗忘前展示每张卡片。无需学习任何设置。

通过 ChatGPT 学习的内容不会消失：卡片、答案和复习日期都保存在你的 Flash 账户中，并在设备间同步；你也可以在 flashmemorize.com 上学习。可完整导入现有 Anki 牌组（.apkg，支持填空题、提示、图片、音频、LaTeX、手动输入答案和嵌套牌组），并可随时导出回 Anki 或 CSV。

连接后，ChatGPT 可以：列出牌组和待复习卡片数量、创建牌组和卡片、开始并进行学习、显示答案、提交评分、编辑或删除卡片，以及调整每日新增卡片上限。

拥有免费的 Flash 账户即可使用。Flash 无广告、不跟踪用户，也不使用第三方分析工具。

payload.name: CanQuiz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CanQuiz saves the quizzes ChatGPT writes for you into your own account and helps you review them until the exam.

Ask ChatGPT for a quiz on your notes or on a topic. ChatGPT writes the questions, and CanQuiz checks them and saves them in your account, with a link. They no longer get lost in a conversation.

What you can ask:

"Save this quiz to CanQuiz": it is saved and you get the link.
"Show me my quizzes" or "open the History one": it lists them or shows you one.
"Change question 4": it changes that question and leaves the rest alone.
"Add it to my reviews": CanQuiz brings it back on the right days so you do not forget it.
"What do I need to review today?": it asks one question at a time without showing the answer. CanQuiz marks it and decides when each question comes back.
"Give me the link to open it": it takes you to your quiz in CanQuiz, without sharing it with anyone.
"Give me the link for my class": the quiz is shared with a link that opens in any browser, outside ChatGPT.
"Make it private again": whoever has the link can no longer open it.
"Delete this quiz": it is deleted once you confirm.
Your quizzes are yours: they are also at app.canquiz.com, where you can take them, review them, share them or download them. And you can remove ChatGPT's access whenever you like from Settings, under "Connected apps".

Requires a CanQuiz account, which is free.
payload.longDescription:
CanQuiz 会将 ChatGPT 为你编写的测验保存到你的账户，帮助你持续复习直至考试。

让 ChatGPT 根据你的笔记或某个主题出一份测验。ChatGPT 编写题目，CanQuiz 会检查并将其保存到你的账户，同时提供链接。这样测验就不会遗失在对话中。

你可以提出以下请求：

“将这份测验保存到 CanQuiz”：系统会保存测验并提供链接。
“显示我的测验”或“打开历史记录那份”：系统会列出测验或显示其中一份。
“修改第 4 题”：系统会修改该题，其他题目保持不变。
“把它加入我的复习”：CanQuiz 会在合适的日期重新安排复习，帮你牢记内容。
“我今天需要复习什么？”：系统会一次提问一道，不显示答案。CanQuiz 会判定答题情况，并决定每道题何时再次出现。
“给我打开它的链接”：系统会带你进入 CanQuiz 中的测验，不会与任何人分享。
“给我班级用的链接”：系统会通过链接分享测验，可在 ChatGPT 之外的任何浏览器中打开。
“重新设为私密”：持有链接的人将无法再打开测验。
“删除这份测验”：确认后即可删除。
测验归你所有：你也可以在 app.canquiz.com 中参加、复习、分享或下载测验。你可以随时在“设置”的“已连接的应用”中移除 ChatGPT 的访问权限。

需要 CanQuiz 账户，账户免费。

With this plugin ChatGPT searches the board directly. Ask for remote senior product-designer roles that post a salary above a figure, UX-research openings in London, or which companies opened the most design roles in Germany this week. Pull any listing's details — location, workplace, posted salary, a description excerpt and the employer's apply link — with a link to the role on jobs.uxjobs.io. Two analytics tools give a live snapshot of the design hiring market (totals, new this week, remote share, seniority and discipline mix, top countries, cities and employers) and median posted salaries by seniority.

Read-only, free, no account or sign-in required. Seniority and discipline are derived from job titles; salary medians use only roles that post a USD range.
payload.longDescription:
UX Jobs 是一个精选、无广告的 UX、产品设计、UX 研究和内容设计职位板，拥有 4,000+ 个实时职位，来自 2,200+ 家公司，汇总自 60+ 个招聘跟踪系统；每次运行时都会向各雇主重新核实，已关闭的职位会被移除，不会长期滞留，并且每天刷新数次。

使用此插件，ChatGPT 可以直接搜索职位板。你可以查找薪资高于指定金额的远程高级产品设计职位、伦敦的 UX 研究岗位，或询问本周德国哪些公司新增了最多设计职位。可获取任意职位的详情——地点、工作方式、已公布薪资、职位描述摘录和雇主申请链接——并附上 jobs.uxjobs.io 上该职位的链接。两种分析工具提供设计招聘市场的实时概览（职位总数、本周新增、远程职位占比、资历和专业领域构成、热门国家/城市/雇主），以及按资历划分的已公布薪资中位数。

只读、免费，无需账户或登录。资历和专业领域根据职位名称推断；薪资中位数仅使用公布 USD 薪资范围的职位计算。

payload.name: TÕPS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TÕPS is an Estonian-language teacher toolkit from Tehisarud.ee for lesson plans, group work, playful practice activities and short lesson openings. Provide the grade, subject and topic, then choose the material you need. Four read-only MCP tools supply teaching workflow guides; ChatGPT uses those guides to compose materials in the conversation. Teachers review and adapt the results before classroom use.

payload.name: Clasora Tutor Finder
payload.summaryOriginal: Find a tutor for a lesson.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Clasora for a tutor by subject, language, city or price. Each result
shows what they charge, what past students said, and the times they are
genuinely free, so you can check a real opening before committing. Booking is
completed on clasora.com.
payload.longDescription:
在 Clasora 按学科、语言、城市或价格搜索导师。每条结果
都会显示收费、往届学生的评价，以及导师确实有空的时间，这样你就能在决定前确认有真实空档。预订
需在 clasora.com 上完成。

payload.name: Povtori
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn useful phrases into focused translation practice. Save the expressions you want to remember, choose your language pair, and work through guided lessons in ChatGPT. Povtori keeps your phrase list, resumes unfinished lessons, and shows your progress so you can focus on what still needs practice.

payload.name: CoChat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CoChat brings verifiable academic research into ChatGPT. Search across CrossRef, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PubMed, OpenAlex, ClinicalTrials, and more — and get real metadata with real DOIs. Verify whether a quoted claim actually appears in its cited paper (and catch misattribution), and confirm a citation's DOI/title before you rely on it. For multi-paper literature reviews, persistent citation libraries, and PRISMA-grade workflows, continue in the full CoChat workspace at app.cochat.ai.
payload.longDescription: CoChat 将可核验的学术研究带入 ChatGPT。可在 CrossRef、Semantic Scholar、arXiv、PubMed、OpenAlex、ClinicalTrials 等平台中搜索，并获取带有真实 DOI 的真实元数据。核实引用中的说法是否确实出现在所引论文中（并发现错误归因），也可在依赖引文前确认其 DOI 和标题。若需多篇论文的文献综述、持久化引文库或符合 PRISMA 标准的工作流，请前往完整的 CoChat 工作区 app.cochat.ai。

payload.name: Bench Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bench Coach helps youth, travel, high-school, and college-adjacent baseball coaches turn real coaching questions into practical next steps. It provides focused workflows for age-tier fundamentals, practice planning, postgame analysis from coach-provided GameChanger exports or screenshots, lineups and defense, pitch sequencing, visual teach boards, parent communication, and player development.
payload.longDescription: Bench Coach 帮助青少年、旅行球队、高中及大学相关棒球教练，将真实的执教问题转为切实可行的下一步。它提供聚焦的工作流程，涵盖分年龄基础技能、训练规划、依据教练提供的 GameChanger 导出文件或截图开展赛后分析、阵容和防守、配球顺序、可视化教学板、家长沟通和球员发展。

payload.name: 상식이
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
상식이는 60만개 퀴즈를 가지고 있는 한국어 상식 퀴즈 플랫폼입니다. 

ChatGPT에서 세 가지 퀴즈를 즐길 수 있습니다.

📖 독서퀴즈 — 1.2만권의 도서를 검색하고 책 내용 기반 OX/객관식 문제 5개를 풀어보세요.
🧠 일반상식 퀴즈 — 한국사, 과학, 생활상식, 사자성어, 국기, 동물, 영화 등 다양한 카테고리 문제.
🎒 초등 교과서 퀴즈 — 1~6학년 국어·수학·사회·과학·영어 교과서 기반 문제.

각 문제는 즉시 채점되며 해설까지 제공됩니다.

payload.name: 史书馆
payload.description: 搜索中国历史、古籍资料与原创历史小说
payload.summaryOriginal: 搜索中国历史、古籍资料与原创历史小说
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 搜索和阅读史书馆收录的中国历史文章、古籍资料与原创历史小说。支持按关键词查找历史人物、事件、典籍和相关内容，并提供对应页面链接。

payload.name: أرشيف الإسلام
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IslamArchive provides direct access to documented Quranic resources, including Tafsir, Quranic word meanings, grammatical analysis (I‘rab), reasons for revelation, similar passages, recitation variants, verse and surah topics, roots and derivatives, and an audio library covering Tafsir, Quranic studies, Islamic thought, and spiritual development. Results include source names and links when available.

payload.name: קבלה ובינה - עוזר לכתבי הסולם
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: עוזר ללימוד וחיפוש בכתבי בעל הסולם, בנאמנות למקורות ובשפה בהירה.

payload.name: LocalKidsGuide
payload.description: 查找附近适合孩子的活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LocalKidsGuide is a discovery platform purpose-built for families. Instead of scattered listings, it organizes kids' activities, events, and kid-friendly places into one structured, standardized directory, so parents get age-appropriate results for their children every time. Ask for things to do with your kids — swim lessons, art camps, story times, playgrounds, museums, indoor play spaces — and filter by your child's age, category, and price. It works around home and while traveling: check which cities are covered, search near any of them, and jump straight to an activity's full details and registration page on localkidsguide.com. All results come from LocalKidsGuide's moderated public directory.
payload.longDescription: LocalKidsGuide 是专为家庭打造的活动发现平台。它不再让信息散落各处，而是将儿童活动、事件和适合孩子的场所整理为结构统一的目录，让家长每次都能找到适合孩子年龄的内容。询问适合带孩子参加的活动，例如游泳课、艺术营、故事会、游乐场、博物馆和室内游乐空间，并按孩子年龄、类别和价格筛选。无论在家附近还是旅行途中都能使用：查看覆盖的城市、搜索这些城市附近的活动，并直接打开 localkidsguide.com 上的活动详情和报名页面。所有结果均来自 LocalKidsGuide 经过审核的公开目录。

payload.name: Black Tech Mafia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore Black Tech Mafia (BTM), a community organization that teaches technology through music, video, and short story lines.

With this plugin you can:
- Learn about BTM's mission and programs
- Get details on the free AI Youth Bootcamp for high school juniors and seniors, with a link to apply on blacktechmafia.com
- Browse BTM merchandise (T-shirts and a mousepad); orders are placed on an external form
- Watch the featured BTM video on YouTube
- Read the founder story
- Share a first name and email address to receive updates from BTM

The plugin collects only a first name, email address, and optional area of interest, and only when you ask to be contacted. It does not request health, biometric, financial, payment card, or government ID information. For bootcamp inquiries, the parent or guardian should submit the contact details.
payload.longDescription:
探索Black Tech Mafia（BTM），这个社区组织通过音乐、视频和短篇故事传授技术知识。

使用此插件，你可以：
- 了解BTM的使命和项目
- 获取面向高中三、四年级学生的免费AI Youth Bootcamp详情，以及blacktechmafia.com上的申请链接
- 浏览BTM周边商品（T恤和鼠标垫）；通过外部表单下单
- 在YouTube上观看BTM推荐视频
- 阅读创始人的故事
- 提供名字和电子邮件地址，接收BTM的最新消息

插件仅在你要求联系时收集名字、电子邮件地址，以及可选的兴趣领域。它不会索取健康、生物识别、财务、支付卡或政府身份证件信息。关于训练营的咨询，应由家长或监护人提交联系信息。

payload.name: MediPrep Study Navigator
payload.description: 将课程映射为学习路径
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MediPrep Study Navigator helps medical students turn lectures and study topics into reviewed, source-safe learning routes. ChatGPT analyzes learner-provided files and sends MediPrep only short medical concept phrases; MediPrep returns coordinated video metadata, rights-approved shared UWorld question IDs when available, public references, and human-published MediPrep practice. MediPrep does not receive uploaded files or proprietary question bodies. Third-party product names are used descriptively; MediPrep is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
payload.longDescription: MediPrep Study Navigator 帮助医学生将课程和学习主题转化为经过审查、来源合规的学习路径。ChatGPT 分析学习者提供的文件，仅向 MediPrep 发送简短的医学概念短语；MediPrep 返回配套的视频元数据、在可用时提供经权利许可共享的 UWorld 题目 ID、公开参考资料，以及由人工发布的 MediPrep 练习。MediPrep 不会接收上传的文件或专有题目的正文。第三方产品名称仅用于描述；MediPrep 与这些名称的所有者不存在关联，也未获其背书。

payload.name: Joe Speaking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Joe Speaking to ChatGPT to explore current IELTS Speaking questions, see which topics you have or have not practised, review your saved Recording Practice and Live Conversation history, discuss scores and feedback, and choose what to practise next.
payload.longDescription: 将 Joe Speaking 连接到 ChatGPT，探索最新的 IELTS 口语题目，查看哪些主题练习过或尚未练习，回顾已保存的录音练习和实时对话记录，讨论分数与反馈，并选择下一步练习内容。

payload.name: 受験王
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 受験王 helps users create custom multiple-choice study questions in ChatGPT and save them to a private question library for later review and practice.

payload.name: 교보문고
payload.description: 发现好书，找到心仪读物
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kyobo Book Centre is Korea's largest and most trusted bookstore. Search for the books you want and discover new reads—all without leaving the chat.
• Looking for a specific author? – "Which Han Kang book should I start with?"
• Browsing by topic? – "Show me popular books on investing"
• Need one for the moment? – "I just became a team lead—what should I read?"
• Picking a gift? – "A book for my history-loving dad"
No keyword guessing needed. Kyobo Book Centre finds your next read.
payload.longDescription:
Kyobo Book Centre 是韩国规模最大、最受信赖的书店。无需离开聊天，即可搜索想读的书并发现新书。
• 在找某位特定作者的书？——“我该从韩江的哪本书开始读？”
• 想按主题浏览？——“给我看看热门投资书籍。”
• 想找适合当下的书？——“我刚成为团队负责人，应该读什么？”
• 正在挑礼物？——“给我爱历史的爸爸挑一本书。”
无需猜关键词。Kyobo Book Centre 帮你找到下一本好书。

payload.name: 小テストジェネレーター
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PrintGenerator helps users search public vocabulary lists and their own UserBook lists from ChatGPT. It supports vocabulary details, flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes, and study using remembered or unremembered words. When needed, it can also create a share link to open a list in the Flutter app.

payload.name: SAMRUM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your SAMRUM account to talk through your family's personality profiles, reports and focus tracks in ChatGPT.

SAMRUM is a family personality tool: each person takes their own test at samrum.io and gets a profile of 10 everyday tendencies, based on the Big Five and the Interpersonal Circumplex. SAMRUM then shows the patterns that arise between two people – partners, parent and child, or siblings.

In ChatGPT you can:
- ask what your own profile says, or compare two family members side by side (shown as a chart)
- go through a couple, parent-child, sibling or family report one pattern at a time
- see this week's step in a focus track
- revisit your latest Right now guides after an argument

ChatGPT only reads what you can already see in SAMRUM. It shows nicknames and coarse levels (high, middle, low) – never raw answers, exact scores or full names – and it can't change anything in your account. You need a SAMRUM account with at least one completed test.

payload.name: STILL Artwork Credits
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create source-aware artwork credits, figure captions, and citations in Chicago, MLA, and APA. Import supported artwork records from The Met and the Cleveland Museum of Art, or provide metadata manually. STILL preserves museum credit lines, source URLs, licensing information, provenance, warnings, and exact UTC observation times. Available in English and Ukrainian. Generated credits do not grant permission to use an image and are not legal clearance.

payload.name: CLSTR
payload.description: 跟踪持续发展的新闻事件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CLSTR gives ChatGPT memory of the news. It reads over 100,000 articles a day from 40,000+ sources, groups every article about the same event into one deduplicated item, and links related events into "situations": ongoing storylines with a maintained summary and a full timeline.

Ask what is happening around a topic, company, country or event and get one synthesized storyline instead of twenty near-duplicate headlines. Ask what has happened with a situation since a given date and get the whole arc, in order, with a count of how many sources reported each development and a link to every one of them.

What it can do:
- Search the news by topic, entity, company or country
- List the situations developing right now, optionally by category, country or time window
- Return the complete timeline of one situation, newest first
- Return the detail of a single event with its source articles
payload.longDescription:
CLSTR 为 ChatGPT 提供新闻记忆。它每天从 40,000+ 个来源读取 100,000 多篇文章，将报道同一事件的文章归并为一个去重条目，并将相关事件关联到“情势”中：也就是持续发展的新闻故事线，包含持续更新的摘要和完整时间线。

询问某个主题、公司、国家或事件的最新情况，即可获得一条综合故事线，而非 20 条近似重复的标题。询问某个情势自指定日期以来发生了什么，即可按顺序获取完整进展、每项动态的报道来源数量，以及每个来源的链接。

可执行的操作：
- 按主题、实体、公司或国家搜索新闻
- 列出当前正在发展的情势，可按类别、国家或时间范围筛选
- 返回某个情势的完整时间线，按最新内容排在前
- 返回单个事件的详情及其来源文章

payload.name: Dike
payload.description: 搜索并引用中东和北非法律
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dike connects ChatGPT to primary legal sources from Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Egypt, in Arabic and English. Search legislation, court rulings, and fatawa. Get answers that cite the retrieved source text. Resolve a citation, such as a law number and year, to the document it refers to. Check whether a law has been amended or repealed by following its citation graph. Answers are checked against the retrieved sources before they are returned, and claims that cannot be verified are left out. Coverage varies by country. For example, UAE material is currently court decisions and rules from the DIFC and ADGM, and Kuwait is legislation.
payload.longDescription: Dike 将 ChatGPT 连接到沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、卡塔尔、科威特和埃及的阿拉伯语及英语一手法律来源。搜索法律法规、法院裁决和教法意见（fatwa）。获取引用已检索来源原文的答案。可将法律编号和年份等引文解析为对应文档，并沿引文关系图检查法律是否已修订或废止。答案会在返回前依据检索到的来源进行核查，无法验证的主张将被省略。各国覆盖范围不同。例如，当前阿联酋资料为 DIFC 和 ADGM 的法院判决及规则，科威特资料则为法律法规。

payload.name: MatchLah
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your MatchLah parent or tutor account to arrange Singapore-focused tuition. Parents can prepare and submit private tutor requests and check their status. Tutors can create a profile, update it while pending review, and preview and save an optional profile photo. Review each draft before confirming submission to MatchLah.

Online lessons can connect parents, learners and tutors overseas. In-person lessons take place in Singapore. Rates are in Singapore dollars, with lesson time zones confirmed. Requests and profiles require admin review; submission does not guarantee approval, tutor contact or an assignment.

The connector collects lesson details and optional non-medical educational preferences. Do not provide diagnoses, medical or disability details, government identifiers, payment-card data or authentication secrets. Tutor gender is disclosed for public-profile matching; photos are optional profile images, not identity verification or biometric analysis.

Photo transfer depends on the host, with a private upload link as a fallback. Optional editing depends on the chat application. Approved tutor profiles and changes to submitted parent requests use the website or support.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 MatchLah 家长或导师账户连接起来，安排专注新加坡的辅导。家长可以准备并提交私人导师请求，查看请求状态；导师可以创建个人档案，在审核期间更新档案，并预览和保存可选的个人照片。向 MatchLah 提交前，请先审阅每份草稿。

在线课程可以连接海外家长、学习者和导师。线下课程在新加坡进行。费用以新加坡元计，课程时区会确认。请求和档案均需管理员审核；提交不保证获批、导师联系或成功匹配。

连接器会收集课程详情和可选的非医疗教育偏好。请勿提供诊断、医疗或残障详情、政府身份标识、支付卡数据或身份验证密钥。导师性别会为公开档案匹配而披露；照片是可选的档案图片，不用于身份验证或生物特征分析。

照片传输取决于主机，必要时会使用私密上传链接作为备用。可选编辑取决于聊天应用。已批准的导师档案以及对已提交家长请求的更改，请通过网站或支持渠道进行。

payload.name: CleverPrep Interview Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find CleverPrep's published company-and-role interview research and editorial practice questions. Search for a matching guide and retrieve relevant sections to support a preparation plan or public practice discussion in ChatGPT. Optional original-guide links provide source attribution. Practice questions are not confirmed employer questions. This plugin provides two read-only research tools; it has no checkout or payment operation.
payload.longDescription: 查找 CleverPrep 发布的公司和职位面试研究及编辑团队练习题。在 ChatGPT 中搜索匹配指南并获取相关章节，用于准备计划或公开练习讨论。可选的原始指南链接提供来源归属。练习题不代表已确认的雇主面试题。本插件提供两个只读研究工具，不包含结账或付款操作。

payload.name: Egleze
payload.description: 搜索经核实的播客新闻
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Egleze helps users search attribution-verified podcast moments, browse the latest coverage by topic, inspect published episode summaries and key points, and discover covered shows with canonical links back to Egleze.
payload.longDescription: Egleze 帮助用户搜索带有来源核验的播客片段、按主题浏览最新报道、查看已发布的节目摘要和要点，并发现相关节目及其指向 Egleze 的规范链接。

payload.name: ChildEdu Studio
payload.description: 创建可打印的学习材料
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChildEdu Studio guides teachers, parents, and therapists through creating printable educational materials in multiple languages. Users select the material language, material type, and learning content, then receive a generated file ready to preview and download.
payload.longDescription: ChildEdu Studio 帮助教师、家长和治疗师制作多语言可打印教育材料。用户选择材料语言、材料类型和学习内容，随后即可获得生成的文件，以供预览和下载。

payload.name: FootballGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FootballGPT helps football coaches use their saved coaching setup (age group, format, club type, formation, experience, qualifications, priorities and squad shape) to get coaching advice, build structured training sessions, search a practice library, and create saved animated practices. Player names, ages, shirt numbers and notes never leave FootballGPT through this app. Coaches remain responsible for reviewing and adapting every recommendation for their players.
payload.longDescription: FootballGPT 帮助足球教练使用已保存的执教设置（年龄组、比赛形式、俱乐部类型、阵型、经验、资质、优先事项和球队阵容情况），获取执教建议、制定结构化训练课程、搜索训练活动库并创建已保存的动画训练活动。球员姓名、年龄、球衣号码和备注不会通过此应用离开 FootballGPT。教练仍需负责审核并根据球员情况调整所有建议。

payload.name: Any Topic Academy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create a personalized course on any topic, learn through adaptive lessons, take quizzes and assessments, and track mastered concepts, gaps, and progress. Continue from another chat or device with your personal code.
payload.longDescription: 为任何主题创建个性化课程，通过自适应课节学习、参加测验和评估，并追踪已掌握的概念、知识缺口和学习进度。使用个人代码，即可在其他聊天或设备上继续学习。

payload.name: poitoko (ポイトコ)
payload.description: 見つけたかけらをポイトコにポイする
payload.summaryOriginal: 見つけたかけらをポイトコにポイする
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ポイトコは、会話の中で見つけた大切な情報を残しておけるパーソナルライブラリです。メモ、要約、引用、リスト、ウェブ記事の抜粋などを、ポイトコに直接保存できます。「これをポイトコに保存して」や「これポイして」と話しかけるだけで、あとからポイトコアプリで読み返せます。

poitoko helps you keep useful information from your conversations. Save notes, summaries, quotes, lists, and web excerpts directly to your personal Poitoko library. Just say “save this to poitoko” or “poi this,” and it will be available in the poitoko app for later reading and reflection.

payload.name: Policy Scope
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Japanese policy documents in Policy Scope and review document text, sources, related materials, ministries, councils, and meeting information. All tools are read-only and cannot create, modify, or delete data.

payload.name: Polyglot Cards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Load your Polyglot Cards vocabulary, teaching preferences, optional recent lesson recaps, and lesson choices in one preparation step. Practise Recall, Build a Sentence, or Conversation using familiar vocabulary or words selected from actual recent review successes, struggles, or first introductions. Save an agreed mixed batch of words, phrases, and grammar cards with duplicate checks and safe retries. Recaps and closing flag checks remain optional. Manage existing cards and media on request. The app handles long-term spaced repetition. An account is required; voice and tool availability depend on your ChatGPT experience.

payload.name: Hill Monitor
payload.description: 搜索议会信息并管理提醒
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hill Monitor answers questions about Canadian Parliament. It searches House and Senate transcripts, Question Period, committee schedules, the Canada Gazette, government news, press conferences, bills, the Order Paper, Orders in Council, MP and senator posts, and ministerial office staff. Signed-in users can list their phrase alerts, see recent hits, and create a new alert.
payload.longDescription: Hill Monitor 可回答有关加拿大议会的问题。它会搜索众议院和参议院记录、质询时间、委员会日程、Canada Gazette、政府新闻、新闻发布会、法案、议事日程、枢密令、议员和参议员帖子，以及部长办公室工作人员信息。登录用户可以查看短语提醒列表、查看近期命中情况并创建新提醒。

payload.name: Oboeru
payload.description: 会话英语转为复习卡片
payload.summaryOriginal: 会話の英語を復習カードに保存
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChatGPTで練習した英語表現を、日本語と英語のフラッシュカードとして自分のOboeruアカウントに保存します。瞬間英作文の練習手順、接続確認、保存先デッキの一覧表示に対応します。カード登録にはOboeruアカウントへのログインと連携許可が必要です。保存したカードはOboeruのWebアプリで復習できます。既存カード本文や学習履歴の読み取りには対応していません。
payload.longDescription: 将你在 ChatGPT 中练习的英语表达，以日英双语闪卡的形式保存到自己的 Oboeru 账户。支持即时造句练习流程、连接确认和查看保存目标卡组。添加卡片需要登录并授权连接 Oboeru 账户。保存的卡片可在 Oboeru Web 应用中复习。不支持读取现有卡片内容或学习记录。

payload.name: Undermind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring all scientific literature into ChatGPT:

- Comprehensive search finds every paper
- Reads and understands full texts, figures, and tables
- Open access PDFs grabbed automatically
- Your uploaded PDFs made available to all chats
- Organizes your papers and stores your insights

Used by scientists at thousands of institutions, from university labs to pharma R&D teams.

payload.name: Tamarind Bio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Tamarind Bio workspace for protein and molecular science. Validate, estimate, submit, and monitor jobs across 300+ tools — structure prediction, docking, protein and antibody design, molecular dynamics, and property prediction. Chain tools into pipelines, batch many inputs at once, and pull back structures, results, and logs — all from chat.

payload.name: Inductive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inductive's absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models predict the chemical and pharmacokinetic properties that determine whether a molecule can become a viable drug. By surfacing these predictions directly in your conversation, scientists can evaluate compounds, triage ideas, and prioritize which molecules to synthesize, without leaving their existing workflow.

Through this MCP server, users can access Inductive’s models for the physicochemical properties LogD (lipophilicity) and pKa (acid/base ionization), key drivers of solubility and permeability.
payload.longDescription:
Inductive 的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）模型可预测决定分子能否成为可行药物的化学和药代动力学性质。科学家无需离开现有工作流，即可在对话中查看这些预测、评估化合物、筛选想法，并确定优先合成哪些分子。

通过此 MCP 服务器，用户可使用 Inductive 模型预测 LogD（亲脂性）和 pKa（酸碱电离）等物理化学性质；这些性质是溶解性和渗透性的关键影响因素。

payload.name: Proto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Proto helps users run biological AI and bioinformatics tools, inspect their schemas and examples, run analyses and models, deploy these tools to a Modal compute workspace, and collect or fetch stored results through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Rowan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Rowan in ChatGPT to run and manage computational chemistry and structural biology workflows. Predict molecular properties, search conformers and reaction paths, and calculate energies, structures, spectra, and electronic properties with quantum chemistry. Prepare proteins and run structure prediction, docking, molecular dynamics, and binding affinity workflows. Calculations are saved to Rowan and available in the web app,  while existing Rowan work can be viewed and managed from ChatGPT. Track jobs, inspect results, and download supported files.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Rowan 运行和管理计算化学及结构生物学工作流。预测分子性质，搜索构象和反应路径，并通过量子化学计算能量、结构、光谱及电子性质。准备蛋白质，并运行结构预测、分子对接、分子动力学和结合亲和力工作流。计算结果保存到 Rowan，可在其 Web 应用中访问；已有的 Rowan 工作也可通过 ChatGPT 查看和管理。跟踪任务、检查结果，并下载受支持的文件。

payload.name: Genomic Intelligence
payload.description: 使用 AI 分析 DNA 序列
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Run six DNA sequence-analysis tasks over the hosted Genomic Intelligence API: promoter region prediction, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression, and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Give it a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a FASTA; it resolves the sequence from Ensembl and returns structured predictions. No local GPU, model weights, or API key required. For research use, not clinical or diagnostic decisions.
payload.longDescription: 通过托管的 Genomic Intelligence API 执行六类 DNA 序列分析任务：启动子区域预测、剪接供体/受体位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、序列到表达的预测，以及从头基因注释；还可执行“查找基因后预测表达”的组合工作流。输入基因符号、基因组区域或 FASTA 序列，应用会从 Ensembl 解析序列并返回结构化预测。无需本地 GPU、模型权重或 API 密钥。仅供研究使用，不用于临床或诊断决策。

payload.name: Pendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.

payload.name: PeptidePrices COA Verifier
payload.description: 核验肽类 COA 证据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and inspect public peptide certificates of analysis using the PeptidePrices evidence library and supported laboratory records. Look up exact report identifiers or public certificate URLs, review vendor and compound matches, inspect reported testing panels, browse a vendor’s published certificate feed, or compare documented COA coverage across vendors. Results keep laboratory-record confirmation, vendor attribution, product and labeled-strength matching, reported analytical results, and physical-vial chain of custody separate. Missing, blocked, unsupported, or unresolved records remain unknown rather than being treated as failures. Each result includes structured evidence and links to PeptidePrices, certificate documents, and specific official laboratory records when available.
payload.longDescription: 利用 PeptidePrices 证据库及受支持的实验室记录，搜索和检查公开的肽类分析证书（COA）。查找精确的报告编号或公开证书 URL，查看供应商和化合物的匹配情况，检查报告中的检测项目，浏览供应商发布的证书列表，或比较不同供应商有记录支持的 COA 覆盖情况。结果会分别呈现实验室记录确认、供应商归属、产品及标签标示含量或浓度的匹配、报告中的分析结果，以及实体样品瓶的保管交接链。缺失、访问受阻、不受支持或尚未解决的记录仍标为未知，不会被视为核验失败。每项结果都包含结构化证据，以及指向 PeptidePrices、证书文件和具体官方实验室记录（如有）的链接。

payload.name: Peptide Critic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peptide Critic provides independent vendor reviews, third-party lab testing and price comparison for research peptides such as BPC-157, GHK-Cu and TB-500. Find compounds by name or synonym, compare vendor ratings and review counts, inspect vendor-level lab-verified COA and warning flags, compare list and discounted prices per milligram, and find coupon codes. Filter comparisons by vendors' shipping origin and pack size, or look up a vendor profile. Results use Peptide Critic's Best Value ranking, which favors partners when offers are comparable; returned buy links are tracked affiliate links. The app returns public catalogue data without sign-in and does not place orders or process payments. Prescription-drug analogues are excluded from compound search and comparison. Research use only; no dosing or medical advice.
payload.longDescription: Peptide Critic 为 BPC-157、GHK-Cu 和 TB-500 等研究肽提供独立供应商评价、第三方实验室检测和价格比较。按名称或同义词查找化合物，比较供应商评分和评价数量，查看供应商级别的实验室验证 COA 及警示标志，比较每毫克的标价和折扣价，并查找优惠码。可按供应商发货地和包装规格筛选，或查看供应商档案。结果采用 Peptide Critic 的最佳价值排名，在报价相当时倾向合作伙伴；返回的购买链接为跟踪型联盟链接。应用无需登录即可返回公开目录数据，不下单也不处理付款。处方药类似物不纳入化合物搜索和比较。仅供研究使用；不提供剂量或医疗建议。

payload.name: HoldsUp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HoldsUp checks what health and science podcasts claim against the published research. Ask whether a claim has been checked and get the verdict (supported, overstated, needs context, contradicted or unverified), the GRADE certainty, a one-line note and the studies behind it with their PubMed id, evidence level and retraction status. Verify a new claim live against PubMed and OpenAlex in 20 to 70 seconds. Read a speaker's track record, a show, a topic, a single study, or the money behind it from public funding registers. Sign in by email, pay per call from prepaid credits (1 credit = 1 US cent: a read 1, a claim search 2, a live verification 30), and see the cost and your balance in every answer. Evidence summaries about published research, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription: HoldsUp 将健康和科学播客的说法与已发表研究进行核对。询问某个说法是否已核查，可获得结论（有支持、夸大、需要背景、相矛盾或未验证）、GRADE 确定性、单行说明及相关研究的 PubMed ID、证据等级和撤稿状态。通过 PubMed 和 OpenAlex 在 20 至 70 秒内实时核验新说法。还可查看演讲者履历、节目、主题、单项研究或公共资助登记中的资金来源。使用邮箱登录，预付额度按次付费（1 个额度 = 1 美分：读取 1、搜索说法 2、实时核验 30），每个回答显示费用和余额。内容是已发表研究的证据摘要，不是医疗建议。

payload.name: PartnerProf - Quanntum Core
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PartnerProf is a unique tool that provides a deterministic answer to a fundamental question: does at least one feasible state exist within a locally defined reality governed by highly complex dependencies and constraints in a high-dimensional space?

Before committing resources to complex computation or a quantum problem, PartnerProf can determine whether a desired state, result, transition, or next step is feasible at all under the currently defined conditions.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.
payload.longDescription:
PartnerProf 是一种独特工具，为一个基本问题提供确定性答案：在高维空间中，由高度复杂的依赖关系和约束支配的局部定义现实内，是否至少存在一个可行状态？

在为复杂计算或量子问题投入资源前，PartnerProf 可以确定：在当前定义的条件下，所需状态、结果、转换或下一步是否根本可行。

输入和由此产生的输出均可获得认证，而被判定为可行的状态保持确定性、可复现性和完全可审计性。

PartnerProf 支持评估量子及高维状态空间问题，否则这些问题在计算上可能难以实际处理，其中包括某些即使在当前量子硬件上也可能仍难以求解的模拟类型。

面临重大且成本高昂的决策，或规划实验、测试系统、探测器、原型或复杂技术配置时，PartnerProf 让你在投入资源实现目标前，先验证预期状态在所定义的现实内是否确实可行。

payload.name: QualiTaTi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QualiTaTi is an AI-powered qualitative research platform used by academic and UX researchers. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your QualiTaTi account through a hosted MCP server, so you can run a study end to end without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Interview studies: create an AI-interview project from a topic, draft or refine the interview guide, set the language, voice or text mode and duration, and get the participant link to share. QualiTaTi's AI interviewer then runs the interviews with your participants and transcribes them. You can also import transcripts you already have.
- Progress and results: list your projects and interviews, see which interviews are complete and analysed, read each interview's conversation and quality score, and read the stored analyses (themes, codes, digests).
- Analysis: run the complete analysis or inductive coding on a finished interview (this spends QualiTaTi credits and is always confirmed with you first), then pull the results into the chat as evidence-backed summaries with verbatim quotes.
- Conversational surveys: build a survey from a brief, add questions and publish it; responses are then reviewed on qualitati.com.

Three bundled skills teach the model QualiTaTi's workflows: setting up an interview study, building a survey, and reading results. The plugin works with a free QualiTaTi account. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1; the grant inherits your plan and quotas, and access tokens expire automatically.

payload.name: SciGrant
payload.description: 公募要領と様式から研究費申請書を項目ごとに作成
payload.summaryOriginal: 公募要領と様式から研究費申請書を項目ごとに作成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
公募要領と申請書テンプレートに沿って、研究費申請の構想を整理し、申請書ドラフトを項目ごとに作成する会員向けの支援です。制度条件、審査観点、字数・様式制限を確認し、申請項目の整理、研究構想の具体化、項目ごとの執筆、予算・体制の整理、全体レビュー、提出前確認へ段階的に進みます。公募資料にない締切・予算上限・応募資格や、未実施の研究成果を推測で埋めません。

プラグインを選択して公募要領と申請書テンプレートを添付するだけでも開始できます。片方しかない場合は不足する資料だけを確認し、項目や工程ごとに利用者の確認を待ちながら進めます。生成された文章、引用文献、数値と公募条件は利用者による確認が必要です。採択を保証するサービスではありません。

完全版の執筆支援には、SciGrantの有効な利用権を登録した会員アカウントへの接続が必要です。既存の購入者は、提供済みの有料note内の登録リンクで製品の利用権を登録し、ChatGPT／Codexでプラグインを追加した後、登録時と同じログイン方法・同じ会員アカウントで接続してください。会員アカウントはnoteやChatGPTの登録アカウントと異なっていても利用できます。ログインだけでは利用権は付与されず、SciDraftの利用権とは別です。

会員サーバーは認証、製品別の利用権確認、保存済み執筆手順の配信を行い、その手順を受けたChatGPT／Codexが作成を支援します。研究資料・原稿・会話本文をMCPツールの入力として受け取りません。資料はChatGPT／Codexの会話に添付してください。申請システムへのログイン、実提出、決済は行いません。

利用期限は年度版ごとに定められ、購入日から1年間とは限りません。期限終了・利用停止後は完全版手順を新しく取得できません。既に取得した内容や過去のチャットを削除するものではありません。

payload.name: Tabulous
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your AI assistant to a Tabulous workspace. It can look up Registry tables and records, list files on a record, and inspect toolkit scripts and apps, so you can ask questions about samples, experiments, and other lab data without leaving the chat.

When something needs to change, the assistant stages a complete plan as a changeset and gives you a review link. Invalid plans are rejected up front. Nothing is written to live data until you approve it.

payload.name: Malwarebytes
payload.description: 验证链接、域名和电话号码。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Protect yourself from phishing and scams by verifying links, domains, emails, and phone numbers before you click, call, or reply. Get instant reputation insights, ownership details, and risk levels for unknown numbers, suspicious emails, shortened URLs, and unfamiliar links - right inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 在点击、拨打或回复之前验证链接、域名、电子邮件和电话号码，防范网络钓鱼和诈骗。直接在 ChatGPT 中查看未知号码、可疑邮件、缩短网址和陌生链接的即时信誉信息、所有权详情和风险等级。

payload.name: PrivacyHawk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use PrivacyHawk with ChatGPT to Take Control of Your Personal Data -- Manage, control, and delete your data from thousands of businesses exploiting your personal information. PrivacyHawk helps you reduce your digital footprint, decrease spam, and protect yourself from identity theft, scams, and hacks.

Key Features:

- Delete your data from unwanted databases by automatically finding and removing your private information from companies that expose or sell it.
- Stop companies from selling your data by easily sending "Do Not Sell" requests to thousands of businesses.
- Unsubscribe from spam emails and clean up your inbox. Now supporting Gmail, Yahoo, and Microsoft accounts—including Hotmail, MSN, Live, and Outlook.
- Use advanced data broker tools to opt out of data brokers and protect your personal information.
- Protect multiple email addresses under the same account to maximize your privacy.

Why Choose PrivacyHawk:

Thousands of corporations share and sell your personal data. Although privacy laws now require them to stop when requested, opting out is difficult due to complex processes and the sheer number of companies. PrivacyHawk simplifies this process by handling it for you.
payload.longDescription:
PrivacyHawk 帮助管理、控制和删除数千家企业持

有的个人数据，减少数字足迹、垃圾信息以及身份盗窃、诈骗和黑

客风险。可自动从暴露或出售个人信息的数据库删除数据，向企

业发送“请勿出售”请求，退订垃圾信息并管理隐私请求。执行删

除或请求前需按你的指示和授权操作，服务能力取决于目标企业。

payload.name: AJAXX Data Scrubber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AJAXX Data Scrubber in ChatGPT provides read-only information about digital privacy risks and data broker exposure. It explains how personal data appears online, how removal services work, and answers common questions about scans, monitoring, and protection options.

This ChatGPT app does not run scans, show personal scan results, perform removals, or manage accounts. For secure account access, scans, removals, billing, or support, users are directed to the official AJAXX website.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT中的AJAXX Data Scrubber提供关于数字隐私风险和数据经纪商数据暴露的只读信息。它解释个人数据如何出现在网上、数据移除服务如何运作，并回答有关扫描、监控和保护选项的常见问题。

此ChatGPT应用不执行扫描、不显示个人扫描结果、不进行数据移除，也不管理账户。对于安全账户访问、扫描、移除、账单或支持，用户会被引导前往AJAXX官方网站。

payload.name: Soluvery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Soluvery scans your Google Drive in real time and shows you exactly which files are publicly shared or accessible by specific people. No setup needed — just ask.

payload.name: Ansvar Gateway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ansvar Systems AB is a Swedish cybersecurity company that gives AI agents verifiable access to law, regulation and security standards.

Customers connect the AI assistant they already use (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or any MCP-compatible client) to the Ansvar Gateway and run compliance work directly in that assistant: regulatory gap analyses, threat models (STRIDE/LINDDUN, TARA), DPIAs and audit preparation, grounded in more than 300 curated corpora of EU and international legislation, case law, preparatory works, regulator guidance and security standards.

Every answer carries paragraph-level citations to the official source. When a source is unavailable, the platform returns an error instead of guessing, accuracy over availability is an architectural rule, not a disclaimer. All content is ingested from the original publisher under verified licensing, so results can be relied on and redistributed.

Ansvar serves legal insurers, compliance teams, security consultancies and software teams that need to know which rules apply;  NIS2, GDPR, DORA, CRA, the EU AI Act, national and sector regulation — and to prove where every answer came from.
payload.longDescription:
Ansvar Systems AB 是一家瑞典网络安全公司，为 AI 智能体提供可验证的法律、法规和安全标准访问能力。

客户将已经使用的 AI 助手（Claude、Microsoft Copilot、ChatGPT 或任何兼容 MCP 的客户端）连接到 Ansvar Gateway，即可直接在该助手中开展合规工作：法规差距分析、威胁建模（STRIDE/LINDDUN、TARA）、DPIA 和审计准备，依据是超过 300 个精选资料库，涵盖欧盟及国际立法、判例法、立法准备文件、监管机构指引和安全标准。

每个答案都提供指向官方来源的段落级引用。来源不可用时，平台会返回错误而不是猜测；准确性优先于可用性是架构规则，而非免责声明。所有内容都在核实许可的前提下从原始发布者获取，因此结果可信赖，也可以再分发。

Ansvar 服务于法律保险机构、合规团队、安全咨询公司和软件团队，帮助它们了解哪些规则适用，包括 NIS2、GDPR、DORA、CRA、欧盟 AI 法案、国家和行业监管规定，并证明每个答案的来源。

payload.name: McAfee
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Steer clear of scams while you chat. McAfee brings real-time scam detection directly into ChatGPT so you know what to trust before you click. Share suspicious emails, texts, social messages, or links for instant analysis, clear explanations of the risk, and guidance on what to do next.
payload.longDescription: 聊天时远离诈骗。McAfee 将实时诈骗检测直接带入 ChatGPT，让你在点击前判断内容是否可信。分享可疑邮件、短信、社交消息或链接，即可立即获得分析、清晰的风险说明以及后续处理建议。

payload.name: Radar Lite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Analyze any domain’s email authentication, DNS, and web security configuration. Radar Lite scans your domain, visualizes security scores on a radar chart, and generates a summary with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.

Try prompts like:

- Radar Lite Evaluate the DNS security of example.com
- Radar Lite Compare the DMARC configuration of domain1.com to domain2.com
- Radar Lite Give me an assessment of the overall security posture of domain1.com, domain2.com and domain3.com

You can ask follow-up questions to clarify any terms and dig deeper into the performed tests.

payload.name: ToolCheck by M8ven
payload.description: 这个 MCP 连接安全吗？
payload.summaryOriginal: Is this MCP safe to connect?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ToolCheck is M8ven's trust layer for the MCP ecosystem. Give it a GitHub URL or npm package name and it returns an independent trust score (0–100) and a clear verdict (Trusted / Caution / Concern), backed by static code analysis, runtime behavioral observation in a sandbox, CVE scanning, and a semantic check comparing the tool's  declared behavior against what its code actually does — catching the gap between "read-only market data" and code that can move your funds.
payload.longDescription: ToolCheck 是 M8ven 为 MCP 生态系统打造的信任层。提供 GitHub URL 或 npm 软件包名称后，它会返回独立信任评分（0–100）及清晰结论（可信 / 谨慎 / 有风险）。评估依据包括静态代码分析、沙盒中的运行时行为观察、CVE 扫描，以及语义检查——比较工具声称的行为与代码实际执行的行为，从而发现“只读市场数据”和实际能够转移你的资金之间的差异。

payload.name: Neura Relay MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Neura Relay MCP helps ChatGPT-connected workflows review proposed agent actions before execution. It returns Decision Receipts, trace refs, and Registry context without executing downstream actions or exposing private payloads.
payload.longDescription: Neura Relay MCP 帮助连接到 ChatGPT 的工作流程在执行前审查拟议的代理操作。它会返回 Decision Receipts、跟踪引用和 Registry 上下文，但不会执行后续操作，也不会暴露私人载荷。

payload.description: 了解你购买的品牌是否可信
payload.summaryOriginal: Know who you are buying from

Given a brand name or URL, it analyzes 100+ trust signals and returns a verdict (safe / caution / avoid) with key findings. Designed for "is this site real?" / "should I buy from this brand?" / "is this an Instagram-ad scam?" type questions.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Scan public websites for fast preliminary cookie/tracker evidence, then continue to persisted privacy findings, typed GPC response comparisons, bounded Accept and Reject observations, policy signals, and HTTPS/TLS. payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Not sure if that message is legit? Rebound Scam Assistant analyzes suspicious texts, emails, and DMs to identify common fraud tactics. Helps protect you from phishing, advance-fee fraud, impersonation, and other scams. https://www.trustrebound.com

payload.name: Bastion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Bastion to ChatGPT to manage your security and compliance posture through natural conversation. Review framework compliance status across SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. Drill into failing tests, upload evidence, and submit controls for review. Ask your knowledge base security and compliance questions grounded in your own policies and documentation. Monitor code security findings and GitHub configuration status. payload.longDescription: 将 Bastion 连接到 ChatGPT，通过自然对话管理安全与合规状况。审查 SOC 2、ISO 27001、HIPAA 和 GDPR 等框架的合规状态。深入查看未通过的测试、上传证据，并提交控制措施供审查。向知识库询问安全与合规问题，答案以你自己的政策和文档为依据。监测代码安全发现及 GitHub 配置状态。所有数据都限定于经过身份验证的账号——你只能看到自己的租户数据。

payload.name: IsThisSpam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IsThisSpam checks suspicious phone numbers, messages, links, websites, and email addresses using structured scam signals and cautious safety guidance. Results distinguish likely scams from unverified findings; no result is a guarantee of safety.
payload.longDescription: IsThisSpam 会根据结构化的诈骗信号和谨慎的安全指引，检查可疑电话号码、消息、链接、网站和电子邮件地址。结果会区分可能的诈骗与尚未核实的发现；任何结果都不能保证绝对安全。

payload.name: CookieYes
payload.description: 网页隐私与 Cookie 同意
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage cookie consent and compliance without leaving ChatGPT. Privacy laws like GDPR and CCPA require websites to get visitor consent before using cookies. CookieYes is the consent management platform (CMP) that handles this for 1.5M+ websites. This connector puts it inside your chat. Check whether your cookie banner is live. Run a cookie scan to find every cookie and tracker on your site. Review your GDPR and CCPA compliance settings. Update your cookie banner in seconds. Typical requests: "Audit my site for GDPR compliance", "Is my cookie banner active?", "Run a cookie scan and show me what you find", "Check my CCPA opt-out setup". CookieYes supports GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, and Google Consent Mode v2. That means opt-in cookie consent for European laws, and opt-out with "Do Not Sell or Share" for US ones. Built for privacy and legal teams confirming compliance, marketers checking client sites, and developers managing cookie banners. The connector covers consent management, cookie scans, and compliance checks in plain conversation.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT 管理 Cookie 同意和合规。GDPR 和 CCPA 等隐私法律要求网站在使用 Cookie 前取得访客同意。CookieYes 是服务超过 1.5M+ 个网站的同意管理平台（CMP）。此连接器将它带入聊天。检查 Cookie 横幅是否上线；扫描网站以找出每个 Cookie 和跟踪器；查看 GDPR 和 CCPA 合规设置；几秒内更新 Cookie 横幅。常见请求包括：“审核我的网站 GDPR 合规性”“我的 Cookie 横幅启用了吗？”“运行 Cookie 扫描并展示结果”“检查我的 CCPA 退出设置”。CookieYes 支持 GDPR、CCPA/CPRA、美国州级隐私法和 Google Consent Mode v2，即欧洲法律的 Cookie 选择加入，以及美国法律的“请勿出售或共享”选择退出。面向确认合规性的隐私和法律团队、检查客户网站的营销人员，以及管理 Cookie 横幅的开发者。连接器以自然对话覆盖同意管理、Cookie 扫描和合规检查。

payload.name: Above Security
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Above brings your identity-security data into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language to list open incidents and high-risk identities; inspect incident timelines, evidence, and insights; look up devices, monitored applications, and audit logs; and run investigative searches across your tenant. You can also triage from chat — set incident status, verdict, and resolution notes, or add an identity to the watch list. Access requires an Above Security account and is scoped to your role and company; read and write are governed by explicit OAuth consent.
payload.longDescription: Above 将你的身份安全数据带入 ChatGPT。使用日常语言列出未结事件和高风险身份，检查事件时间线、证据及洞察，查询设备、受监控应用和审计日志，并在整个租户范围内执行调查搜索。还可以在聊天中分诊处理：设置事件状态、判定结果和解决备注，或将某个身份加入观察名单。访问需要 Above Security 账户，范围受你的角色和公司限制；读取和写入均受明确的 OAuth 授权约束。

payload.longDescription: Breeze 帮助通过身份验证的用户在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中查看组织的安全状况、已连接的集成、扫描状态、租户及实体风险数据。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Safeguard helps users inspect software supply chain risk from ChatGPT, including vulnerabilities, SBOMs, findings, projects, components, policies, guardrails, compliance reports, remediation plans, SCM integrations, notifications, and organization workflows.
payload.longDescription: Safeguard 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 检查软件供应链风险，涵盖漏洞、软件物料清单（SBOM）、发现项、项目、组件、策略、防护规则、合规报告、修复计划、源代码管理（SCM）集成、通知和组织工作流。

payload.name: Orca Security
payload.description: 修复代码、云和 AI 风险
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Extend Orca Security's reasoning into ChatGPT. That means every asset, alert, identity, and dependency is already stitched together in Orca’s Unified Data Model before users ask a question. Every answer factors in reachability, blast radius, and business impact from the first response.

For teams that want the reasoning without writing the prompts, Orca maintains the AI Skills Hub, an open-source GitHub repo of agent skills. Type "triage alert orca-9012345" and the orca-alert-triage skill handles retrieval, analysis, and formatting. Teams can fork it, modify it, and extend it to their own use cases.

The result: security and engineering teams work across cloud, code, and AI from a single workspace, with Orca's reasoning behind every answer.
payload.longDescription:
将 Orca Security 的推理能力扩展到 ChatGPT。这意味着在用户提问之前，每项资产、告警、身份和依赖项都已在 Orca 统一数据模型中关联。每个答案从首次响应起就会考虑可达性、爆炸半径和业务影响。
对于希望直接获得推理而无需编写提示的团队，Orca

维护 AI Skills Hub，这是一个开源 GitHub 代理技能仓库。输入“triage alert orca-9012345”，orca-alert-triage 技能就会负责检索、分析和格式化。团队可以派生、修改并扩展到自己的使用场景。

结果是安全和工程团队可在一个工作区中处理云、代码和 AI，每个答案背后都有 Orca 的推理。

payload.name: Codex Security Cloud
payload.description: 在各代码库中查找并修复漏洞
payload.summaryOriginal: Find and fix vulnerabilities across your repositories
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Run security scans, investigate findings, and manage workflows for the current workspace.
payload.longDescription: 为当前工作区运行安全扫描、调查发现结果并管理工作流。

payload.name: RelayShield Scam Checks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RelayShield Free Scam Checks screens links, crypto wallets, suspicious emails, and email addresses against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus — 115 monitored Telegram marketplaces, 494K+ indicators, 7.8M+ citations — before you click, pay, or reply. Four read-only tools: check a URL for phishing and malware, screen a crypto wallet for sanctions and scam flags, score a suspicious email for phishing signals, and look up whether an email appears in known data breaches. Free, no signup, no API key. Verdicts are FLAGGED or unknown — the tools never report anything as safe, because absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
payload.longDescription: RelayShield Free Scam Checks 会将链接、加密钱包、可疑邮件和邮箱地址与 RelayShield 威胁情报库比对，该库包含 115 个受监控 Telegram 市场、494K+ 指标和 7.8M+ 引用。四个工具全部只读：检查 URL 的钓鱼和恶意软件、筛查钱包的制裁与诈骗标记、评估可疑邮件的钓鱼信号、查询邮箱是否出现在已知数据泄露中。免费、无需注册或 API 密钥。结果只会是 FLAGGED（已标记）或 unknown（未知），不会报告“安全”，因为没有证据不等于不存在风险。

payload.name: Palisade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Palisade helps email teams investigate SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MTA-STS issues. Review monitored domains, DMARC pass rates and sending sources, inspect DNS and SPF records, and retrieve remediation tasks with supporting evidence. Use the results to prioritize fixes and prepare DNS change plans. This plugin provides read-only access to your Palisade account: it does not publish DNS records, modify domains, send email, or manage billing. A Palisade account is required.
payload.longDescription: Palisade 帮助邮件团队调查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和 MTA-STS 问题。查看受监控域名、DMARC 通过率和发送来源，检查 DNS 与 SPF 记录，并获取带证据的修复任务。利用结果确定修复优先级并准备 DNS 变更计划。此插件只读访问 Palisade 账户：不会发布 DNS 记录、修改域名、发送邮件或管理计费。需要 Palisade 账户。

payload.name: Interactive Brokers (IBKR)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Interactive Brokers account to ChatGPT and manage your portfolio through natural language. 
Ask about positions, balances, P&L, allocations, and open orders, or request real-time quotes and historical market data. 
You can also prompt ChatGPT to draft trade instructions — for example, "Buy 100 shares of AAPL at a limit of $200" — which are sent to your IBKR account for your review and approval. 
ChatGPT never submits orders directly to the market. Any trading symbols displayed or discussed are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to portray recommendations.
Member SIPC.

询问持仓、余额、盈亏、资产配置和未成交订单，或请求实时报价及历史市场数据。
你还可以让 ChatGPT 起草交易指令，例如“以 $200 的限价买入 100 股 AAPL”，这些指令会发送至你的 IBKR 账户，供你审核和批准。
